newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks fall to sharp losses on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks fall to sharp losses on Monday.

text.p: Madrid bourse ended sharply lower on Monday reflecting a decline on Wall Street last Thursday, when the Spanish market was shut, and a late fall.
The general index ended down 7.51 points, or 1.56 percent, to 473.06. The Ibex-35 registered a decline of 96.40 points, or 1.75 percent, to 5,424.28.
"Except for the final half hour the day was very boring. The lower Wall Street meant paper at the close and the last half hour a good part of the session's business was done," a trader said.

Market activity was one of the lowest of the years, with a value of just 21.26 billion pesetas, far beneath a typical value of 80 to 90 billion pesetas, changing hands. Some 40 percent of that volument was done in the last half hour.
Dealers said they expected further volatility ahead, with the downward pressure in debt and on Wall Street.
